artboards.title: Today · a stop with a note

annotations.text:
THE WAY IN

Sign in, then Trips, then New trip, then the trip opens on Today.

New trip asks for dates and nothing else that matters. A starting city and a name are both optional. Leave the name blank and the trip is called Fukuoka until stops appear in a second and third city, at which point it becomes Japan. Naming rules are in PLAN.md section 4d.

The G mark on the sign-in button is a PLACEHOLDER for the asset Google ships.

ADDING PLACES

Search is biased to the open day, not the whole planet. Places API takes a locationBias circle of up to 50 km, so the centre is the day's stops and the radius is a chip you can widen. Results outside it still appear, greyed, with the distance. Things already on the trip say so instead of offering to add twice.

Sign-in is Google. Drive is a separate, later consent, asked only when you first attach a file - see PLAN.md section 5.

PLANNER

Click any empty cell and the search opens right there, already scoped to that day and that hour. The sidebar is To be planned: uncollapsed, scrollable, everything not on a day yet. Two rows along the bottom: travel and where you sleep.

The plus at each end of the grid extends the trip by a day, so a trip that runs long or gets cut short is a click rather than a settings screen. The arrows by the view switcher page through a trip too long to fit.

Three ways to shape the day list. A is what the app screens are built on, because it is what you described. B and C are here so you can see what you are giving up. They are sketches, not proposals - say the word and I will build one out properly.
